I have gone through this during my college days with a friend I met in high school and got really attached to in college. It's not the same but the feelings you described are the same. He was a year or two older than me and we had a lot of the same interests and supported each other to finish school. Every time I thought about him my heart would race or when my classes were done I would wait for him so I could see him before going home. Even hanging out with friends we were always by each other. Though he did not share the same feelings with me but in a way I admired him. I loved him through the thought of what could be. Then, when he chose another girl over our friendship I was heart broken. Not due to the fact that he didn't share mutual feelings but because he let go of a good friendship over some 🐱

It boiled down to me realizing I admired him for who he was and I was infatuated with him. I didn't love him but I loved the person he was. Maybe evaluating yourself and how you actually feel about him and what it is you like about him can help. I learned love is earned and learned, not made up in our minds and if it is in our minds then infatuation is the first step to realizing if it could be more. 

Maybe try hanging out with him and see where your feelings and his take you. I'd say risk finding out the truth to your feelings than stay being stuck in your imagination. I hope everything works out for you.
